problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.commentary:

problems.legend: Some plants ___ seeds by using the wind.

어떤 식물들은 바람을 이용해 씨앗을 퍼뜨린다.
